review.tapPlayAgain: Ku sake taɓa kunna don saurara.

review.clipNotKept: An kasa ajiye wannan guntun murya. Ku sake gwadawa, ko ku rubuta sharhi.

review.nameFirst: Ku fara rubuta sunanku. Kowane suna zai yi.

connect.title: Haɗa manhaja
connect.intro: Ku ba manhajar sauraro, shafin yanar gizo ko wakilin AI damar shiga fassarorin ƙungiyarku. Zai iya yin abin da kuka zaɓa a nan kaɗai, kuma ba fiye da abin da ku kanku za ku iya yi ba.
connect.signInSub: Da asusun da kuke amfani da shi a manhajar LangQuest.
connect.requestTitle: Wata manhaja tana neman izinin shiga
connect.codeLabel: Lambar da manhajar ta nuna muku
connect.makeSub: Don manhaja ko wakilin da kuka saita da kanku. Kuna ganin maɓallin sau ɗaya, don haka ku kwafe shi zuwa wuri mai aminci.
connect.somethingWrong: Wani abu bai yi daidai ba ({{status}}).
connect.wrongPassword: Imel ɗin da kalmar sirrin ba su yi daidai ba.
connect.everyLanguage: Kowane harshe da nake iya gani
connect.includingLater: Har da waɗanda za a ƙara daga baya
connect.cannotReview: (ba za ku iya yin bita ko fassara a nan ba, don haka ba zai iya naɗa bitoci ba)
connect.never: Ba zai ƙare ba (ku soke shi a nan idan an gama)
connect.notShownAgain: Ba za a sake nuna shi ba.
connect.mcp: Ko ku ƙara LangQuest ga wakilin AI a matsayin sabar MCP:
connect.name: Suna
connect.madeExpires: An yi {{when}} · amfani na ƙarshe {{used}} · zai ƙare {{expires}}
connect.revokeConfirm: A soke wannan maɓalli? Duk abin da ke amfani da shi zai daina aiki nan take.
connect.stateApproved: An amince da wannan buƙata. Manhajar za ta iya ci gaba.
connect.checkCode: Ku tabbata wannan ya dace da lambar da manhajar take nunawa.
connect.askedMinutes_one: An nema minti {{count}} da ya wuce.
connect.askedMinutes_other: An nema minti {{count}} da suka wuce.
connect.approveOnly: Ku amince kawai idan ku da kanku kuka fara wannan, a manhaja ko wakilin da ke gabanku. Idan wani ya aiko muku wannan mahaɗi, ku ƙi shi.
connect.selfNamed: Wannan shi ne sunan da manhajar take kiran kanta. LangQuest ba zai iya tabbatar da shi ba, don haka ku amince da manhajar da kuka nemi haɗawa yanzu kaɗai.
connect.writesUnticked: Duk abin da ke rubutu da sunanku (bitoci, fitarwa, ƙimomin waje) yana farawa ba a zaɓa ba: ku zaɓe shi idan manhajar tana buƙatarsa kaɗai.
connect.denied: An ƙi. Manhajar ba ta samu komai ba.
connect.approved: An amince. An haɗa {{app}}; kuna iya rufe wannan shafi. Ku soke shi a ƙasa a kowane lokaci.
connect.noOrganization: Ba ku cikin ƙungiya mai harsuna tukuna, don haka babu abin da za a haɗa.
connect.notConfigured: Wannan sabar ba ta da saitin shiga (SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).

scopes.readPublished: Karanta sigar da aka amince da ita ta kowane nassi kuma kunna sautinsa
scopes.read: Karanta kowane nassi da aka raba don bita, tare da sigoginsa da bitocinsa
scopes.review: Naɗa bitoci da sunanku: sharhin masu sauraro, ko matakin bita a cikin tsarin, tare da sharhi ko saƙon murya
scopes.release: Faɗi inda aka wallafa siga (a cikin manhaja ko a shafin yanar gizo), ko inda aka sauke ta
scopes.externalValues: Ajiye ƙimomin manhajar tare da harsunanku, da sunanku. LangQuest yana riƙe su kuma ba ya taɓa amfani da su
